title: Using DeepContact with Amira graphical user interface
protocol: Restart Amira when changing python environment.
Click Project -> open data, and select an image file for processing.
Right click on the image panel, select AI -> Deep Contact Prediction -> Create.
Define “Deep Contact Prediction” functional parameters in “Properties” interface.
Select “Single” or “Batch” in Inputs: Single processes initially selected data with direct visualization in Amira; Batch requires selection of an input folder and an output folder.
